relationships_and_distinctions: Output of ready Placement Readiness; consumed by Broker Protocol/execution bridge; distinct from broker adapter, submission, execution receipt, fill and Live Position state.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: broker order; execution request; placement receipt; broker protocol
rationale_and_evidence: The contract rejects broker-execution and donor execution-record keys and requires execution_allowed=false; this proves carrier separation, not operational readiness.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed protocol-boundary term for broker-facing message shape, constraints and mode while concrete adapter selection, credentials, submission and receipts remain separately owned. Scope: protocol semantics only.
semantic_owner: execution-bridge/broker-boundary protocol authority; no concrete operational writer admitted here
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Placement Handoff at a future authorised seam; distinct from the handoff carrier, broker adapter implementation, order placement and execution receipt.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: broker adapter; broker API; order execution; placement handoff
rationale_and_evidence: The row-5.12 seam permits broker readiness context but prohibits implementation detail beyond the handoff contract; current working status says broker operation is not established.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed per-position state representing one open or lifecycle-tracked position and its declared source evidence after entry. Scope: one position identity and state record.
semantic_owner: position-state authority through its repository contract
relationships_and_distinctions: Contained and read by Inventory Architecture; input to Exit Architecture; distinct from opening/readiness/handoff, inventory aggregate, exit decision and close completion.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: opening authorisation; inventory; order; candidate; close state
rationale_and_evidence: The blueprint allocates per-position state after entry and the ownership supplement separates it from opening and aggregate inventory; alpha process-memory records remain non-durable.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed row-5.13 architecture for identifier-keyed position state, inventory snapshots, declared exposure, capital-state reads and receipts. Scope: aggregate live-inventory structure after entry.
semantic_owner: live inventory authority together with bounded position and capital-state authorities
relationships_and_distinctions: Aggregates Live Position states and lawful capital/exposure facts; supplies Exit Architecture and review/replay; distinct from one position, opening authority and close authority.
lawful_aliases: live inventory architecture; inventory state architecture
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: live position; portfolio strategy; opening architecture; exit architecture
rationale_and_evidence: The core says inventory outputs do not answer the opening/capital question; the working ownership law limits exposure to declared stored values and records current volatility.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed row-5.14 decision architecture for evaluating live-position state, policy and risk context into hold, trim-ready, close-ready or blocked exit state. Scope: exit-policy judgement and trace.
semantic_owner: exit and close authority, specifically the exit-policy decision owner
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Live Position/Inventory Architecture truth; may trigger Close Architecture handoff; distinct from position state, inventory ownership, broker execution and confirmed closure.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: close execution; broker close order; inventory mutation; position state
rationale_and_evidence: The blueprint allocates exit downstream of live state; the current contract explicitly fixes broker_execution_opened, live_inventory_mutated and capital_sizing_recomputed to false.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed closure architecture for protocol-only close handoff, close receipt/replay evidence and the future separately authorised confirmation of position wind-down. Scope: close transition after Exit Architecture decision.
semantic_owner: exit and close authority, specifically the closure-transition owner; execution and inventory owners retain their own writes
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes trim-ready/close-ready Exit Architecture decision; emits CloseHandoffMaterial and ExitCloseReceipt; confirmed closure later requires broker/execution evidence and lawful Live Position/Inventory updates.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: exit decision; broker close order; live inventory; position closed merely because handoff exists
rationale_and_evidence: Current contracts are intentionally non-executing and replayable. The semantic architecture preserves a later confirmed closure transition without falsely claiming that the alpha handoff performs it.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed downstream evidence layer that reports repo-native capital, position and receipt reads, distinguishes execution-record truth from truthful placeholders, and reserves recommendation-history/every-pass receipt concerns without policy. Scope: downstream state-read evidence only.
semantic_owner: downstream state-reader authority; capital, position and receipt repositories retain semantic and write ownership
relationships_and_distinctions: Reads bounded repo-native state for downstream opening/inventory/review consumers; distinct from Inventory Architecture aggregation, Live Position state, behavioural decisions, Parallel Risk Stage-read observations and replay reconstruction.
lawful_aliases: downstream repo-native state reader; downstream state reader
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: Stage-read State; behavioural decision packet; inventory decision; capital decision; state mutation owner
rationale_and_evidence: Core lines 183-195 establish this layer, its exact output questions and its prohibited behavioural authority. Ownership is assigned from that proposition, not phrase similarity to Parallel Risk Stage-read State.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed independent advisory lane that evaluates admitted temporal, regime and options/flow primitives into an environmental risk envelope, caution/block observations and traceable packet. Scope: row 5.8 independent risk observation.
relationships_and_distinctions: Runs alongside Serial Desk-cognition; may be consumed by downstream pre-deployment/capital/final-risk/review but remains distinct from candidate formation, posture permission and capital deployment.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: serial risk stage; capital risk authority; candidate builder; portfolio arbiter
rationale_and_evidence: The core explicitly separates environmental reading from candidate formation and fresh-capital judgement; current code is observation evidence only.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed advisory observation describing present temporal/regime/options-flow conditions and the independent risk-envelope state. Scope: environment-only assessment inside Parallel Risk Lane.
relationships_and_distinctions: Feeds the lane packet and may coexist with Candidate Audit; distinct from serial stage outputs, candidate semantics, review explanation and deploy/stand-down authority.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: market regime context; candidate audit; capital risk decision; trade recommendation
rationale_and_evidence: Higher normative authority expressly defines the lane-owned output as an independent assessment/reading of the present environment. Code is only corroborating observation evidence.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Observed alpha candidate-relative audit helper; no canonical vocabulary scope admitted.
relationships_and_distinctions: The independent lane is normatively environment-focused; current lower surfaces do not establish a separately governed candidate-audit concept.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: vocabulary candidate audit; candidate formation; final risk decision; capital sizing
rationale_and_evidence: No proposition-level higher authority was found. The fixed concept list and code/contracts cannot admit the term.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Observed alpha per-stage read-status helper nested in Parallel Risk contracts; no canonical vocabulary scope admitted.
semantic_owner: Unassigned pending a higher normative proposition specifically admitting a separate per-stage read-status record.
relationships_and_distinctions: Observed alongside ParallelRiskInputTrace but not established by its normative trace proposition; distinct from the downstream state-reader layer governed under PM-008.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: canonical Parallel Risk trace surface; downstream state-reader layer; normative replay record
rationale_and_evidence: The fixed list opens review only. The cited normative propositions do not establish a distinct per-stage read-status record; current contracts/code/tests cannot admit meaning. Quarantine is therefore required.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed persistence interface that accepts one typed Parallel Risk observation record, rejects duplicate observation identity and returns an append receipt. Scope: lane-owned observation writes only.
relationships_and_distinctions: Stores Append-only Observation Records produced from lawful packet pairs; distinct from lane evaluation, Review Layer, decision ledger and durable replay system.
lawful_aliases: parallel-risk observation store; PRL observation store
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: risk decision engine; observation database as durable by default; review repository
rationale_and_evidence: Ownership law expressly says the writer is append-only and downstream callers read-only, while warning that process memory does not satisfy durability.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed access/authority constraint on the Parallel-risk Observation Store: append is exposed to the lane-side writer, while observation readback is absent from that operational interface. Scope: writer-facing persistence semantics.
relationships_and_distinctions: Qualifies the store interface; complements Append-only Observation Record; does not mean data is irretrievable forever or physically durable.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: durable persistence; no audit access ever; fire-and-forget decision; append-only record
rationale_and_evidence: The current class exposes append only and returns a receipt; treating that as durable or replay-complete would be false.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed immutable observation record linking one observation identity to input/output packet identities, execution-context identities, lineage and bounded observation payload. Scope: one recorded lane occurrence.
semantic_owner: parallel-risk observation persistence authority for record form; source/lane owners retain field meaning
relationships_and_distinctions: Stored by Parallel-risk Observation Store; append receipt confirms accepted identity; distinct from mutable lane state, decision output or review summary.
lawful_aliases: parallel-risk observation record; PRL append record
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: updatable observation row; current lane state; capital receipt; review record
rationale_and_evidence: Higher normative ownership law expressly governs append-only observations/records, duplicate rejection, insertion order and non-durable alpha storage. Code only corroborates the current form.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed post-runtime evidence, trace and replay-comparison surface that assembles review records and audit summaries from preserved packets, receipts, decisions and proof outputs. Scope: review and comparison, not decision execution.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes lane/serial/capital/downstream/persistence evidence; may produce Explanation Layer inputs; distinct from runtime owner, observation store and playbook authority.
lawful_aliases: trace review layer; runtime review layer
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: runtime arbiter; decision override; risk lane; explanation as exact synonym
rationale_and_evidence: Core review law requires ownership separation understandable in plain language and expressly forbids treating review receipts as operating decisions.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed post-runtime explanatory surface that translates cited review/runtime evidence into bounded human-readable text or explanation packets. Scope: explanation and trace communication only.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Review Layer records and/or preserved owner outputs; distinct from the review comparison itself, free-form generation, runtime decisions and playbook definitions.
lawful_aliases: runtime explanation layer; human-readable explanation surface
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: trade advice; decision rationale owner; review layer as exact synonym; free-form generation
rationale_and_evidence: The review blueprint prohibits live decisions/state mutation and the deterministic PRL renderer rejects action language, supporting a non-deploying explanation boundary.

bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed registry/library architecture for playbook definitions, setup families/variants, eligibility constraints, selection metadata and proofable metadata receipts. Scope: playbook-owned content and registry meaning.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumed by Playbook Eligibility through explicit contracts; outputs definitions/candidates/metadata receipts but does not itself decide runtime eligibility, capital, broker, exit or close.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: Playbook Eligibility; strategy engine; capital/playbook selector; execution playbook authority
rationale_and_evidence: Working ownership prohibits capital, broker, execution, exit/close and hidden coefficient authority in playbook material and labels current implementation a thin seam.
